title: OnTemp
description: Displays world time information and other information.
body:
Configurable client-side mod that helps track time and some additional information about the world, such as weather, moon phases, etc.


## Dependencies:
- YetAnotherConfigLib (YACL)
- Mod Menu

## Features:
- adds time bar on screen
 
![day time bar on screen](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b5e2884055cad4a809aeed06c2e79de4dad8331c.png)

![night time bar on screen](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/17c87a64b6d9a1fd523ab65fbdcd5bc6f6e65ef5.png)

- adds hints with additional information:
Weather status, 
Moon phase,
Total ticks,
Day ticks,
Day count
  
![hints with additional information](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d393f38bae90622faf92ea33753b523f8c2b0a79.png)

- adds detailed configuration

![hints configs](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9cd289585450da39ba87cef739b2793935fe73d4.png)

![texture and other configs](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/10a9951d2d991bb145fd0b6457cdd9c2da29b197.png)

## Misc:

You are welcome to add this mod to any modpack you'd like.
